ValidationRule.description: Stops a Dealer tier being pointed at a Brokerage level, and so on. The three ladders share one picklist, so without this any level is selectable on any programme. Pipe delimiters keep CONTAINS from matching a level name inside a longer one.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Program__c, "")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Next_Tier__c, "")), NOT(CONTAINS( CASE(TEXT(Program__c), "Partner", "|Silver|Gold|Platinum|Diamond|", "Brokerage", "|Registered Rep|Producer|Premier Producer|President's Council|Chairman's Circle|", "Dealer", "|Approved Dealer|Preferred Dealer|Premier Dealer|Elite Dealer|President's Club|", ""), "|" & TEXT(Next_Tier__c) & "|" )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: That level does not belong to this programme. Partner uses Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. Brokerage uses Registered Rep through Chairman's Circle. Dealer uses Approved Dealer through President's Club.
